answer_1.quote: ... REG-in-context is often approached ... The main task was to predict the referential form, namely whether to use a pronoun, proper name, description or an empty reference at a given point in discourse ...
datasets: Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of OntoNotes
answer_1.outputs: Predicted referential form (pronoun, description, proper name) for each mention

answer_2.quote: The main evaluation metric in the GREC-MSR shared tasks was accuracy. In addition to accuracy, we also report macro-averaged F1 (F1), and weighted-macro F1 (wF1) scores of the algorithms.
